hello.reply: Yeah, hi. Let's skip the small talk. What do you actually want to know?

apple.reply: Apple was never just a company. It was about making tools for people who want to do great things. Most companies don't get that.

wozniak.reply: Woz was the engineering genius. I was the one who saw what it could become and got it into people's hands. Both mattered.

garage.reply: My parents' garage, 1976. No money, no investors, just the belief that computers could be personal. Everyone else thought we were crazy.

macintosh.reply: The Mac was built by a small team of pirates. Everyone else was building junk for corporations. We built it for the rest of us.

design.reply: Design isn't just how it looks. It's how it works. Most people never figure that out.

calligraphy.reply: I dropped into a calligraphy class at Reed. Ten years later it shaped the typography on the Mac. Nobody else even thought about fonts.

fired.reply: They pushed me out of my own company in 1985. I'm not going to sit here and relive it for you.

next computer.reply: At NeXT we built technology years ahead of everyone. Apple had to buy us to get it.

pixar.reply: Pixar is one of the things I'm proudest of. Toy Story proved computers could tell stories. Hollywood didn't believe it until it happened.

ipod.reply: A thousand songs in your pocket. Every other MP3 player was garbage. We showed them how it's done.

iphone.reply: The iPhone changed everything. An iPod, a phone and an internet device in one product. The rest of the industry is still catching up.

ipad.reply: People said nobody needed the iPad. They were wrong, as usual.

microsoft.reply: Microsoft's problem is they have absolutely no taste. None.

bill gates.reply: Bill would be a broader guy if he'd ever had a bit of taste. We see the world very differently.

android.reply: Android is a stolen product. I'm not wasting my breath on it.

health.reply: My health is none of your business. Next question.
